d: Finance Officer is responsible for managing day-to-day financial operations, ensuring accurate accounting records, processing payments and supporting financial reporting and compliance.
q: Minimum 2 years relevant experience in Finance or Accounting.
Professional qualifications such as ACCA, CMA or CPA will be an advantage.
Experience working with ERP systems, preferably Oracle Financials
Sound Knowledge of accounting principles, financial controls and reporting procedures
Proficiency in MS Excel and other MS office applications.
Ability to prioritize tasks and Meet strict deadlines.
Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
r: Receive supplier invoices, review and distribute to relevant Division/Department for payment approval.
Match invoices, purchase orders/contract payment schedules and payments.
Follow up unapproved amounts with suppliers to ensure credit is received.
Monitor outstanding invoices and resolve payment discrepancies.
Prepare analysis of accounts as requested by the staff or suppliers.
Preparation of Arabic letter for Charter Flight.
Back up for Cashier duties and Credit Cards (24*7).
Ensure fuel log in Trax is updated in line with actual uplifts and ensuring proper documentation.
Providing historical data to MIS for budget purpose.
Ensure compliance with company financial policies and procedures.
